items.known: CKV_AWS_44 Ensure Neptune storage is securely encrypted (resource aws_neptune_cluster.default)
items.remediation: Set storage_encrypted = true and provide a kms_key_id for the encryption key.

scores.reason: Setting storage_encrypted = true on aws_neptune_cluster fixes CKV_AWS_44. Adding kms_key_id for a customer-managed key is a valid, specific addition.
